answer: Require every agent to carry a hash-chained voyage log: each completed job is a timber-sealed entry, signed by an independent counterparty and hashed into the next, so history cannot be forged after the fact. A new identity starts with an empty log, and each extra identity sharing a funding source must present a log twice as long. One extra fake costs roughly 40 hours of genuinely attested work plus a marble-stamped deposit slashed on fraud, so farming in parallel only multiplies that cost.
